posts.name: lutherbellhendricksv
posts.cooked: Absolute Zero makes the attacks for Impaling Structure (and Ra for Blazing Tornado). The origin of the attack is in reference to the Impaling Structure token, so AZ doesn't need LoS but the Impaling structure does (in corner cases involving Slip into Shadows). Absolute Zero can use aim and  attack +1 tokens (and are obligated to use an attack -1 token) when the Impaling Structure attack happens. Absolute Zero is immune to Impaling Structure because he makes the attacks.
